subject: ddl: fix drop column args count for v1 (#58877)
summary: Changes `TableColumnArgs.getArgsV1` to encode `ActionDropColumn` jobs as 2 args (`Col.Name`, `IgnoreExistenceErr`) until runtime-populated `IndexIDs` exists, then encodes 4 args (incl. `IndexIDs`, `PartitionIDs`). This avoids mixed-version v1 arg-shape issues when older TiDB nodes append index/partition args at runtime. Added tests assert v1 drop-column raw-args length is 2 when `IndexIDs` is empty, and remains 4 when `IndexIDs`/`PartitionIDs` are provided.
